# Bundled English dictionary

Source: Open English Wordnet 2025, maintained by the Open English Wordnet Community, derived from Princeton WordNet.

- Download: https://en-word.net/downloads/english-wordnet-2025-json.zip
- SHA-256: `7d749f6e2c39e6970e4997839dcf6e42fd281f3c2fae0171d2192bae8cfa4b51`
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; see the included license and upstream notices.
- Project and contributors: https://github.com/globalwordnet/english-wordnet

Leafmark converts the source into normalized, partitioned definition/example/synonym records for local browser lookup. This conversion is a modification of the source distribution. It does not imply endorsement by the source authors. No personal books or reading history are included in these files. Builds use the committed archive without downloading data.
